[D] topology
  3号线 branches: 3-1+3-2 share 24 (丁桥站/东岳站/华丰路站/华鹤街站/古墩路站/古荡新村站/古荡站/同协路站/善贤站/大关站/新天地街站/星桥站/桃花湖公园站/武林广场站/武林门站/汽轮广场站/潮王路站/花坞站/西湖文化广场站/西溪湿地南站/香积寺站/黄鹤山站/黄龙体育中心站/黄龙洞站)
    represented as one pack line per branch so no false linear order is invented; the Y topology keeps its three terminals
  6号线 branches: 6-1+6-2 share 22 (三堡站/中医药大学站/丰北站/之江文化中心站/亚运村站/伟业路站/元宝塘站/博览中心站/奥体中心站/建业路站/昙花庵路站/星民站/枫桦西路站/枸桔弄站/江汉路站/江陵路站/火车东站(东广场)站/美院象山站/西浦路站/诚业路站/钱江世纪城站/长河站)
    represented as one pack line per branch so no false linear order is invented; the Y topology keeps its three terminals

[E] lines without realtime ETA support (excluded from the pack)
  杭海城际: not covered by the realtime ETA source (ibus getMetroInfoList)
    raw stations 12, dropped 11, kept because another line serves them 1 临平南高铁站
    dropped: 许村站, 海宁高铁西站, 长安(东方学院)站, 长安东站, 周王庙站, 盐官站, 桐九公路站, 斜桥站, 皮革城站, 海昌路站, 浙大国际校区站
  note: 1-10/16/19 are covered by the realtime source; branch services 3号线往石马 and 6号线往双浦 are reached through routeAliases
  note: the pack schema has no per-line 'no realtime ETA' flag, so an uncovered line cannot be shipped without claiming ETA support it does not have; it is left out instead
  pack lines with no cell data: none

[F] raw fields deliberately not converted
  lo/s/ot: semantics unverified in this pass, never interpreted as coordinates, operator or network identity
  mcc/mnc/tacOrLac: absent from the material, so LOCAL_CID_COMPAT cells carry explicit unknown placeholders (0/0/0); no full-identity data is fabricated

[G] ibus stop names that need an online check against getMetroInfoList
  hz_s160 阳陂湖站 -> 阳坡湖
  hz_s185 火车东站(东广场)站 -> 火车东站(东广场)

conventions baked into the pack
  displayName      raw material station name, trailing 站 kept as-is
  ibusStopName     KEEP-suffix rule + nameFixes, i.e. HangzhouStationNames.toIbusStopName (城站/火车东站/火车西站/火车南站/临平南高铁站/永福站 keep 站)
  line entries     one pack line per raw branch (3-1/3-2, 6-1/6-2), so the Y topology, the branch direction and all three terminals survive without inventing a linear order
  direction        the app builds 往{terminal displayName}; directionKey strips 往/方向/站, so ibus destinan still matches
  station codes    the accepted prototype codes are pinned in station-codes.json, every other station gets hz_sNNN in first-appearance order
  determinism      no timestamps, fixed key order, stable sorting; rerunning over the same inputs rewrites byte identical files

self check (strict decoder equivalent), all passed:
  - top level keys are exactly {city, packVersion, cellMatchMode, lines, stations, cells, nameFixes, routeAliases} (unknown keys rejected)
  - city == 'hangzhou'
  - packVersion == 2
  - cellMatchMode is one of EXACT / LOCAL_CID_COMPAT / CELL_ID_ONLY_DEBUG
  - station codes unique and matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$
  - every station has non-empty displayName, ibusStopName and lineIds
  - line ids are unique
  - every line: id/name present, exactly two terminals matching the first and last station display name, >=2 known stationCodes
  - station.lineIds <-> line.stationCodes are mutually consistent
  - every cell: known stationCode, 64 bit positive cellId, and identity fields consistent with cellMatchMode (placeholder 0/0/0 + mode label for LOCAL_CID_COMPAT)
  - no duplicate (stationCode, cellId) pairs
  - nameFixes entries have exactly {from, to}
  - routeAliases entries have exactly {ibusRouteName, lineName, directionTerminal}, reference an existing line and one of its terminals
